label: Hoard Moment
description: The story beat inside the hoard — items are tagged stealth / parley / wrath so template variants couple via tags_any.

items.name: held-breath
items.text: the intruder frozen mid-step on the coin slope, one dislodged coin ringing away down the drift, the dragon's breathing unbroken somewhere above

items.name: shuttered-lantern
items.text: the lantern shuttered to a single blade of light, swung slowly across the dark to find a path between the outstretched talons

items.name: slow-reach
items.text: a gloved hand a finger's width from the prize, sleeve pinched back so no cuff brushes the coins, eyes turned up toward the sleeping silhouette instead of the treasure

items.name: level-gaze
items.text: the dragon's head lowered level with the intruder, a slit pupil taller than they are narrowing to appraise them, smoke curling politely from one nostril

items.name: coin-punctuation
items.text: a bargain in progress, the intruder's palms open and empty, the dragon idly raking one talon through the coins so that every sentence ends in a slide of gold

items.name: tribute-open
items.text: an offered casket standing open on the coins between them, its contents the only thing in the vault the dragon is not looking at

items.name: coin-avalanche
items.text: the hoard itself avalanching as the dragon surges up from underneath it, coins pouring off the wings in sheets, the whole slope going liquid underfoot

items.name: furnace-throat
items.text: the first furnace-glow kindling deep in the dragon's throat, rib-scales lighting from inside, every coin in the vault turning orange in sequence as the glow swings toward the intruder

items.name: tail-sweep
items.text: a tail-sweep bursting through a mountain of stacked treasure in passing, the vault booming, coins and dust raining out of the dark above while the intruder dives clear
